findings.reason: Named rendered-layout budget. The file header documents why Playwright CT cannot import the TSX owner and why the zero-import TS leaf is the enforced one-home seam. Production component points readers to it; the CT consumes it.
Vite production worker entry is created by new Worker(new URL("./ui-guest.worker.ts", import.meta.url), ...). The liveness graph does not recognize this bundler entry edge.
The live worker imports this module at lines 45-46. It becomes reachable when the missing Worker(new URL(...)) production edge is represented.

proposedRepair: Teach production liveness graph construction to resolve static relative new Worker(new URL(path, import.meta.url), ...) targets as production edges, with red-first TS and TSX fixtures plus a negative dynamic-path control.
